reviewed_server_contract.meaning: Source rationale only; actual selected-candidate client observations remain mandatory.

operations.rationale: Anonymous protocol negotiation is allowed; the returned session must retain its caller identity.
An anonymous session may ping; success must not borrow an authenticated session.
The default anonymous workflow catalog is public. A privileged full-catalog response is not evidence for this anonymous case.
Resource templates may be discovered anonymously; discovery does not grant resource-read authority.
